notes:
### Look and feel
- New design system across all tools: dark and light themes that follow Revit's own theme (re-checked at the start of every command), shared colour tokens, a common type scale and standard dialog widths
- Bundled Source Sans 3 and Source Code Pro fonts
- Reworked shared styles: buttons, radio buttons, combo boxes, tooltips, toasts, dialog titles and one shared Select all / Deselect all row
- Message dialog buttons size to their labels
- Preferences, Breakline settings, Model Health and many smaller dialogs brought to the new spec
- Model Health overview shows full-width verdict rows

### Icons
- New icon set for all tools on the ribbon and the Preferences tiles, with a dot badge on tools that are still in development

### Fixes
- Alignment, column widths and row readability fixed in Match Sheet Positions, Phase Parameter Sync, Telemetry, Find & Replace, V/G Manager, Tag CAD Layers, Move to Geo-Reference, Template Sync and View Template Snapshot
- Template Sync conflict message now names the setting and set
